# Typography Studio

> A free, browser-based studio for designing responsive web typography with live WCAG contrast checking. Built by CRUSH Design.

**Site:** https://www.typographystudio.co.uk/

Typography Studio is a single-page web tool for designers and developers who need to design a responsive type system and verify its colour contrast against WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards. The tool runs entirely in the browser — there is no sign-in, and no user data is stored or transmitted.

## What it does

- Provides a live, side-by-side editor and preview for web typography.
- Lets you set per-element styles (h1–h6, p, blockquote, a, li, small) for font family, weight, size, line height, letter spacing, italic, text transform, and colour.
- Adds per-breakpoint overrides for mobile (375px), tablet (768px), laptop (1280px), and large desktop (1920px), with visual indicators showing which properties differ from the base.
- Calculates WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios in real time, with AA and AAA pass-fail grades for both normal and large text.
- Includes 200+ Google Fonts built in, organised by category (sans-serif, serif, display, monospace, handwriting/script).
- Loads Adobe Fonts (Typekit) web projects via Kit ID, so licensed Adobe fonts appear in the picker alongside the Google Fonts list.
- Exports the result as either mobile-first vanilla CSS (with media queries) or SCSS (with nested media queries), including a WCAG contrast report as comments.

## Who it's for

Designers and front-end developers who are setting up a type system for a new project, retrofitting one onto an existing site, or simply auditing an existing colour pair for accessibility.

## Who made it

Typography Studio is built and maintained by [CRUSH Design](https://www.crush-design.co.uk), a UK design studio. The codebase was vibe-coded in collaboration with Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic.
